descriptionHtml:
This is the first session of the AlgoForge Webinar Series, focused on mastering the fundamentals of Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA). The session covers key topics such as Graph Algorithms (BFS, DFS, Dijkstra, etc.), Sorting Techniques, Greedy Algorithms, and Hashing.

Whether participants are preparing for IEEEXtreme or other coding challenges, this session aims to strengthen their problem-solving skills and provide a solid foundation in DSA.
